scope: posthoc development-prefix diagnosis of native continuation and operational memory-view effects; one task, fixed-seed technical repeats; not task success or recovery effectiveness
selection_reason: Previously analyzed capacity-protect stopping point and its immediate pre-activation prefix; both sources are from the same capacity-protect trajectory, never from separate Full and capacity trajectories.
acquisition_state: fresh and empty for each prepared view; immutable views reused across repeats
wall_scope: live process including setup, frozen-view verification, and gist materialization; zero-model CPU preflight is reported separately
primary_endpoint: a nonempty native tool-call list in which every call has a declared function name and JSON-object arguments; action correctness is not inferred; truncated generations are censored
secondary_endpoint: canonical native action signature, preserving call order and ignoring generated call IDs
repeat_scope: four technical repeats at fixed seed 0 within one task; not four independent seeds
failure_rule: Stop on the first transport, backend, geometry, frozen-input, or budget failure; retain partial results and durable attempt journal; never refill failed cells.
completion_rule: If infrastructure remains valid, finish all 24 predeclared cells regardless of model responses; never add repeats or tasks based on results.

interpretation.A_vs_B: Effect of adding the common evidence presentation to Full history.
interpretation.B_vs_C_or_D: Effect of the complete operational memory view at the same native prefix.
interpretation.C_vs_D: Difference between budgeted memory views, including coverage and representation; not an isolated gist-encoding effect.
interpretation.negative_control: A and C must have identical complete backend payloads reconstructed from the same negative native prefix; compare primary-endpoint drift separately from action-identity drift.
interpretation.stable: All four fixed-seed technical repeats and corresponding block directions agree; this is a local descriptive pattern, not a significance or robustness claim.
interpretation.A_continues_shared_views_stop: Inspect the common evidence renderer before changing retrieval or detector logic.
interpretation.A_B_D_continue_C_stops_with_stable_negat: Inspect C2KV view layout, positions and serving compatibility; do not repeatedly retrieve an already visible source.
interpretation.negative_routes_split: Inspect actual resolved backend request and execution behavior before attributing differences to memory representation.
interpretation.mixed_or_no_reproduced_loss: End this fixed-prefix diagnosis without extending samples or post-draft recovery trials.
